entries.name: Artisan
entries.summary: You began mopping floors and scrubbing tables in an artisan's workshop for a few coppers per day as soon as you were strong enough to carry a bucket.

rules.name: Artisan

entries.name: Charlatan
entries.summary: Once you were old enough to order an ale, you soon had a favorite stool in every tavern within ten miles of where you were born.

rules.name: Charlatan
rules.description: Once you were old enough to order an ale, you soon had a favorite stool in every tavern within ten miles of where you were born.

entries.summary: You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops.

rules.name: Criminal

entries.name: Farmer
entries.summary: You grew up close to the land. Years of tilling the earth have given you patience, and animal husbandry has given you respect for nature.

rules.name: Farmer

entries.name: Guard
entries.summary: Your feet ache when you remember the countless hours you spent walking patrol routes, standing up your post, and hustling after troublemakers.

rules.name: Guard
rules.description: Your feet ache when you remember the countless hours you spent walking patrol routes, standing up your post, and hustling after troublemakers.

entries.name: Guide
entries.summary: You came of age outdoors, far from settled lands.

rules.name: Guide
rules.description: You came of age outdoors, far from settled lands.

entries.name: Hermit
entries.summary: You spent your formative years (and probably some of your adult years) alone, with no one for company but the creatures of forest, desert, or caves.

rules.name: Hermit
rules.description: You spent your formative years (and probably some of your adult years) alone, with no one for company but the creatures of forest, desert, or caves.

entries.summary: You were one part of the great mercantile web that connects buyers and sellers across vast distances.

rules.name: Sage
rules.description: You spent your formative years traveling between manors and monasteries, learning the lore of the multiverse.

entries.name: Sailor
entries.summary: You lived as a sailor, a privateer, or a marine, learning how to tie knots, patch sails, and survive rough seas.

rules.description: You lived as a sailor, a privateer, or a marine, learning how to tie knots, patch sails, and survive rough seas.

entries.name: Scribe
entries.summary: You spent formative years working with documents in a legal office, arcane library, or other scholarly environment.

rules.name: Scribe
rules.description: You spent formative years working with documents in a legal office, arcane library, or other scholarly environment.

entries.summary: You trained for battle, learning tactics, weapons, and discipline.

rules.name: Soldier
rules.description: You trained for battle, learning tactics, weapons, and discipline.

entries.summary: You grew up on the open road, traveling with a band of entertainers, merchants, or nomads.

rules.name: Wayfarer
rules.description: You grew up on the open road, traveling with a band of entertainers, merchants, or nomads.

entries.name: Barbarian
entries.summary: A fierce warrior who can enter a battle rage.

rules.name: Barbarian
rules.description: A fierce warrior who can enter a battle rage.

features.name: Rage
features.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a Bonus Action. While raging, you gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; you have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws; and you deal extra damage when you hit with Strength-based attacks.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You gain an uncanny sense of when things nearby aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge away from danger. You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you Advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.description: You gain proficiency in another skill from the Barbarian skill list.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Your instincts are so honed that you have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.description: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.description: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any Advantage on one Strength-based attack. If that attack hits, it deals extra damage and can knock the target Prone or push them.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: Your Rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 Hit Points while your Rage is active and you don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, your Hit Points instead change to a number equal to twice your Barbarian level.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Your Rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you have the Unconscious condition or you choose to end it.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: You embody primal power. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, and their maximum is now 26.

entries.name: Bard
entries.summary: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

rules.name: Bard
rules.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

fixed: Three musical instruments of your choice

entries.name: Cleric
entries.summary: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

rules.name: Cleric
rules.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

entries.name: Druid
entries.summary: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms.

rules.name: Druid
rules.description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms.

entries.name: Fighter
entries.summary: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

rules.name: Fighter
rules.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one Fighting Style option.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a Bonus Action to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a Short or Long Rest before you can use it again. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on the same turn.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield. When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the check, potentially turning it into a success.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach level 11 in this class and to four when you reach level 20.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest. You can use this feature twice between Long Rests starting at level 13 and three times starting at level 17.

features.name: Master of Armaments
features.description: You are a master of weapons. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can choose one of the weapon Mastery properties you have access to and replace it with another property.

entries.name: Monk
entries.summary: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

rules.name: Monk
rules.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.
weaponProficiencies: Martial weapons that have the Light property

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. You gain benefits while unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and not wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Ki
features.description: Your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of ki. You have a number of Ki Points equal to your Monk level. You can spend these points to fuel various ki features.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain Monk levels.

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.description: When an attack roll hits you and its damage includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce the total damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Monk level.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: You can take a Reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your Monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a Monk weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 1 Ki Point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail.

entries.name: Paladin
entries.summary: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

rules.name: Paladin
rules.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of Hit Points equal to five times your Paladin level.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have learned to draw on divine magic through meditation and prayer to cast spells.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of weapons.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes, using that energy to fuel magical effects.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you makes a saving throw, you can add your Charisma modifier to the saving throw.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have Immunity to the Frightened condition.

entries.name: Ranger
entries.summary: A warrior who combats threats on the edges of civilization.

rules.name: Ranger
rules.description: A warrior who combats threats on the edges of civilization.

entries.name: Rogue
entries.summary: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies.

rules.name: Rogue
rules.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies.
weaponProficiencies: Martial weapons that have the Finesse or Light property

features.name: Expertise
features.description: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage when you hit with an attack if you have Advantage on the attack roll or an ally is within 5 feet of your target.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You picked up various skills during your training. You know Thieves' Cant and one other language.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: You can take a Bonus Action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: You can nimbly dodge certain effects. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

entries.name: Sorcerer
entries.summary: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

rules.name: Sorcerer
rules.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.description: An event in your past left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with simmering magic. As a Bonus Action, you can unleash that magic for 1 minute. For the duration, you have Advantage on your spell attack rolls, and your spell save DC increases by 1.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: You have Sorcery Points that you can use to create spell slots or enhance your spells. You have a number of Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: You gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You learn two Metamagic options of your choice.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you regain expended Sorcery Points equal to half your Sorcerer level (round down).

entries.name: Warlock
entries.summary: A wielder of magic that is derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

rules.name: Warlock
rules.description: A wielder of magic that is derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: In your study of occult lore, you have unearthed eldritch invocations, fragments of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Your arcane research and the magic bestowed on you by your patron have given you facility with spells. You have a number of spell slots that are all the same level.

features.name: Magical Cunning
features.description: If all your Pact Magic spell slots are expended, you can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute, at the end of which you regain half of those spell slots.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Your otherworldly patron grants you a gift that deepens your connection to your patron.

features.name: Contact Patron
features.description: You can cast Contact Other Plane without using a spell slot to contact your patron.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum
features.description: Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one level 6 spell from the Warlock spell list as this arcanum.

entries.name: Wizard
entries.summary: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.

rules.name: Wizard
rules.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: You have learned to regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook. Once per day when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover with a combined level equal to no more than half your Wizard level (rounded up).

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.description: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook.

features.name: Spellbook
features.description: Your spellbook contains the spells you know. You start with six 1st-level Wizard spells of your choice in your spellbook.

features.name: Scholar
features.description: While studying your spellbook, you also delve into arcane theory. You have Expertise in one skill: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion.

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.description: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the spells you have prepared with another spell from your spellbook.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: You have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will. Choose a 1st-level Wizard spell and a 2nd-level Wizard spell that are in your spellbook.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: You gain mastery over two powerful spells and can cast them with little effort. Choose two 3rd-level Wizard spells in your spellbook as your signature spells.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.summary: You increase your abilities through training and self-improvement.

rules.name: Ability Score Improvement
rules.description: You increase your abilities through training and self-improvement.
benefits: Increase one ability score by 2, or increase two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feat.

entries.name: Alert
entries.summary: You develop keen senses that help you act in combat.

rules.name: Alert
rules.description: You develop keen senses that help you act in combat.
benefits: Initiative Proficiency: When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.

Initiative Swap: Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Athlete
entries.summary: You have undergone extensive physical training.

rules.name: Athlete
rules.description: You have undergone extensive physical training.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Climb Speed: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
Hop Up: When you are Prone, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement.
Jumping: You can make a running Long or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.

entries.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
entries.summary: Your combat ability has reached legendary proportions.

rules.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
rules.description: Your combat ability has reached legendary proportions.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Peerless Aim: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
entries.summary: You can slip between dimensions at will.

rules.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
rules.description: You can slip between dimensions at will.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Blink Steps: Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.name: Boon of Fate
entries.summary: You have mastery over fate itself.

rules.name: Boon of Fate
rules.description: You have mastery over fate itself.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

Improve Fate: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
entries.summary: Your attacks are devastating beyond measure.

rules.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
rules.description: Your attacks are devastating beyond measure.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Overcome Defenses: The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance.
Overwhelming Strike: When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat.

entries.name: Boon of Spell Recall
entries.summary: Your mastery of magic allows you to recall spent power.

rules.name: Boon of Spell Recall
rules.prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
rules.description: Your mastery of magic allows you to recall spent power.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Free Casting: Whenever you cast a spell with a spell slot of level 1-4, roll 1d4. If the number you roll equals the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

entries.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
entries.summary: You merge with darkness itself.

rules.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
rules.description: You merge with darkness itself.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

Merge with Shadows: While entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction.
Shadowy Form: While entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

entries.name: Boon of Truesight
entries.summary: You perceive the world in its true form.

rules.name: Boon of Truesight
rules.description: You perceive the world in its true form.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Truesight: You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Charger
entries.summary: You know how to make the most of a charge attack.

rules.name: Charger
rules.description: You know how to make the most of a charge attack.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Improved Dash: When you take the Dash action, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that action.

Charge Attack: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack as part of the Attack action, choose one of the following effects: gain a +1d8 bonus to the attack's damage roll, or push the target up to 10 feet away if it is Large or smaller. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

entries.name: Chef
entries.summary: You are an able cook.

rules.name: Chef
rules.description: You are an able cook.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Cook's Utensils Proficiency: You gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils.

Replenishing Meal: As part of a Short Rest, you can cook special food if you have Cook's Utensils and raw food. You can prepare a number of servings equal to your Proficiency Bonus. At the end of the Short Rest, any creature who eats one serving regains an extra 1d8 Hit Points.

Fortifying Treats: With 1 hour of work, you can cook a number of treats equal to your Proficiency Bonus. These treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can eat one of these treats to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Crafter
entries.summary: You are adept at crafting things.

rules.name: Crafter
rules.description: You are adept at crafting things.
benefits: Tool Proficiency: You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice.
Faster Crafting: When you craft an item using a tool with which you have proficiency, the required crafting time is reduced by 20 percent.
Discount: Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you receive a 20 percent discount.

entries.name: Crossbow Expert
entries.summary: You are an expert with crossbows.

rules.name: Crossbow Expert
rules.description: You are an expert with crossbows.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Ignore Loading: You ignore the Loading property of crossbows.
Firing in Melee: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with crossbows.
Dual Wielding: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you're wielding a crossbow with the Light property.

entries.name: Defensive Duelist
entries.summary: You are skilled at parrying attacks.

rules.name: Defensive Duelist
rules.description: You are skilled at parrying attacks.
benefits: Parry: If you're holding a Finesse weapon and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

entries.name: Dual Wielder
entries.summary: You master fighting with two weapons.

rules.name: Dual Wielder
rules.description: You master fighting with two weapons.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Enhanced Dual Wielding: When you take the Attack action and attack with a weapon that has the Light property, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn with a different weapon, which must be a melee weapon that lacks the Two-Handed property. You don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative.
Quick Draw: You can draw or stow two weapons that lack the Two-Handed property when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

entries.name: Durable
entries.summary: You are tough and hard to kill.

rules.name: Durable
rules.description: You are tough and hard to kill.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Defy Death: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.
Speedy Recovery: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll the die, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll.

entries.name: Elemental Adept
entries.summary: You master spells of a particular element.

rules.name: Elemental Adept
rules.description: You master spells of a particular element.
benefits: Energy Mastery: Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Spells you cast ignore Resistance to damage of the chosen type. When you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
Repeatable: You can take this feat more than once, choosing a different damage type each time.

entries.name: Fighting Style: Archery
entries.summary: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

rules.name: Fighting Style: Archery
rules.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.
benefits: +2 bonus to attack rolls with Ranged weapons

entries.name: Fighting Style: Defense
entries.summary: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

rules.name: Fighting Style: Defense
rules.description: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
benefits: +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor

entries.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
entries.summary: When you roll damage for an attack with a Melee weapon that you're holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.

rules.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
rules.description: When you roll damage for an attack with a Melee weapon that you're holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.
benefits: Treat 1s and 2s on damage dice as 3s when using two-handed melee weapons

entries.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
entries.summary: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack.

rules.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
rules.description: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack.
benefits: Add ability modifier to damage of Light weapon bonus attacks

entries.name: Great Weapon Master
entries.summary: You master the techniques of heavy weapons.

rules.name: Great Weapon Master
rules.description: You master the techniques of heavy weapons.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Heavy Weapon Mastery: When you hit a creature with a weapon that has the Heavy property as part of the Attack action, you can cause the weapon to deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Hew: Immediately after you score a Critical Hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with one, you can make one attack with the same weapon as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Healer
entries.summary: You are an able physician.

rules.name: Healer
rules.description: You are an able physician.

Healing Rerolls: Whenever you roll a die to determine the number of Hit Points you restore with a spell or ability, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Heavily Armored
entries.summary: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor.

rules.name: Heavily Armored

benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Constitution or Strength by 1, to a maximum of 20.

rules.name: Inspiring Leader
rules.description: You can inspire your allies with stirring words.
benefits: Inspiring Performance: At the end of a Short or Long Rest, you can give an inspiring performance by addressing your allies. When you do, choose up to six allies who can see or hear you. Each of them gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Keen Mind
entries.summary: You have an unusually sharp memory.

rules.name: Keen Mind
rules.description: You have an unusually sharp memory.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Lore Knowledge: Choose one of the following skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion. You have Expertise in that skill if you have proficiency in it.
Quick Study: You can take the Study action as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Lucky
entries.summary: You have inexplicable luck.

rules.name: Lucky
rules.description: You have inexplicable luck.
benefits: Luck Points: You have a number of Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can spend Luck Points on the benefits below, and you regain all your Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.
Advantage: You can spend 1 Luck Point immediately after you roll a d20 to give yourself Advantage on the roll.
Disadvantage: When a creature rolls a d20 to attack you or to determine if you fail a saving throw, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give that roll Disadvantage.

entries.name: Mage Slayer
entries.summary: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters.

rules.name: Mage Slayer
rules.description: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Concentration Breaker: When you damage a creature that is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw to maintain Concentration.
Guarded Mind: If you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Magic Initiate
entries.summary: You have learned the basics of a magical tradition.

rules.name: Magic Initiate
rules.description: You have learned the basics of a magical tradition.

1st-Level Spell: Choose one 1st-level spell from the same list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have.
Spellcasting Ability: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).
Repeatable: You can take this feat more than once, choosing a different class each time.

entries.name: Musician
entries.summary: You are a practiced musician.

rules.name: Musician
rules.description: You are a practiced musician.

entries.name: Observant
entries.summary: You are exceptionally perceptive.

rules.name: Observant
rules.description: You are exceptionally perceptive.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Keen Observer: You have a +5 bonus to your Passive Perception and Passive Investigation.
Quick Search: You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Polearm Master
entries.summary: You are an expert with polearms.

rules.name: Polearm Master
rules.description: You are an expert with polearms.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Pole Strike: Immediately after you take the Attack action and attack with a Quarterstaff, Spear, or weapon that has the Heavy and Reach properties, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. The weapon deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage.
Reactive Strike: While you're holding such a weapon, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against a creature that enters the reach you have with that weapon.

entries.summary: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals.

rules.name: Ritual Caster
rules.description: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals.

Ritual Casting: When you cast a spell you have prepared that has the Ritual tag, you can cast it as a Ritual.
Spellcasting Ability: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Savage Attacker

rules.name: Savage Attacker

benefits: Savage Strike: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.summary: You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard.

rules.name: Sentinel

entries.name: Sharpshooter
entries.summary: You are an expert marksman.

rules.name: Sharpshooter
rules.description: You are an expert marksman.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Bypass Cover: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
Firing in Melee: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with ranged weapons.
Long Shots: Attacking at long range doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with ranged weapons.

entries.name: Shield Master
entries.summary: You have mastered using a shield to protect yourself and your allies.

rules.name: Shield Master
rules.description: You have mastered using a shield to protect yourself and your allies.
benefits: Shield Bash: If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the Attack action and hit, you can push the creature up to 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger than you.

Interpose Shield: If you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a Reaction to use your Shield to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw.
Forceful Bash: You can add your Shield's Armor Class bonus to your Strength (Athletics) check to shove a creature within 5 feet of you.

entries.summary: You have acquired skills.

Fog of War: You can take the Hide action when you are Lightly Obscured.
Sniper: If you make an attack roll while Hidden and the roll misses, making the attack roll doesn't end the Hidden condition on you.

entries.name: Spell Sniper

rules.name: Spell Sniper
rules.description: You have learned techniques to enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells.

Casting in Melee: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with spells.
Increased Range: When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and that requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell's range by 60 feet.

entries.name: Tavern Brawler
entries.summary: You are accustomed to brawling.

rules.name: Tavern Brawler
rules.description: You are accustomed to brawling.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Damage Rerolls: Whenever you roll a damage die for your Unarmed Strike, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: You are tougher than most.

entries.summary: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat.

rules.name: War Caster
rules.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat.
benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.

rules.name: Weapon Master

benefits: Ability Score Increase: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

rules.name: Dragonborn
rules.description: The ancestors of dragonborn hatched from the eggs of chromatic and metallic dragons. One story holds that these eggs were blessed by the dragon gods Bahamut and Tiamat, who wanted to populate the multiverse with people created in their image.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10). You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry

traits.name: Trance

entries.name: Halfling

features.name: Survivor
features.description: You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your Hit Points remaining. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 Hit Points.

entries.name: Circle of the Land
entries.summary: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition.

rules.name: Circle of the Land
rules.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition.

features.name: Land's Aid
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend a use of Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of you. Vitality-giving flowers and life-draining thorns appear for a moment in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: You can cast one of the spells of 1st level or higher from your Circle Spells list without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can do so again.

features.name: Nature's Stride
features.description: Moving through nonmagical Difficult Terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or similar hazards.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: Nature spirits rise to protect you when you are badly hurt. If you have the Bloodied condition, you can take a Reaction when a creature you can see targets you with an attack to force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target or lose the attack.

entries.name: Circle of the Moon
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of the wilds. Their order gathers under the full moon to share news and trade warnings.

rules.name: Circle of the Moon
rules.description: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of the wilds. Their order gathers under the full moon to share news and trade warnings.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: You have learned to use Wild Shape in combat. You gain benefits related to your Wild Shape.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: The might of the moon helps you assume more powerful forms. You can Wild Shape into forms with a Challenge Rating as high as your Druid level divided by 3 (round down).

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.description: While in Wild Shape, you gain additional benefits based on your Druid level.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.description: You magically transport yourself from one moonbeam to another. When Moonbeam is a spell you have prepared, you can cast it without expending a spell slot. While Moonbeam is active, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within the spell's area.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.description: While in Wild Shape, you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

entries.name: Circle of the Sea
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of the Sea draw on the tempestuous forces of oceans and storms.

rules.name: Circle of the Sea
rules.description: Druids of the Circle of the Sea draw on the tempestuous forces of oceans and storms.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to create an aura of ocean spray around you. The aura lasts for 10 minutes and moves with you. You can end it early (no action required). The aura has effects detailed in the feature description.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. In addition, your Wrath of the Sea's radius increases to 15 feet, and when you deal Cold damage with it, you deal extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: Your Wrath of the Sea's radius increases to 20 feet. In addition, you have Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.description: You can grant aquatic abilities to creatures. As a Bonus Action, you touch a willing creature and give it a Swim Speed equal to its Speed. The creature can also breathe underwater.

entries.name: Circle of the Stars
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of the Stars trace their patterns among the stars, looking for meaning in the celestial movements.

rules.name: Circle of the Stars
rules.description: Druids of the Circle of the Stars trace their patterns among the stars, looking for meaning in the celestial movements.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: You've created a star chart as part of your heavenly studies. While holding the map, you have these benefits: You know the Guidance cantrip; you have the Guiding Bolt spell prepared, it counts as a Druid spell for you, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you have prepared.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to take on a starry form rather than transforming into a beast. While in starry form, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You choose which of three constellations glimmers on your body: Archer, Chalice, or Dragon.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can consult your Star Map for omens and roll a die. The roll determines whether you have a Weal or a Woe omen, which affects how you can help or hinder creatures.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: The constellations of your Starry Form improve and you can change your constellation at the start of each of your turns.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

entries.name: College of Dance
entries.summary: Bards of this college consider dancing a more potent art form than music or speech.

rules.name: College of Dance
rules.description: Bards of this college consider dancing a more potent art form than music or speech.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.description: Your practice of dance gives you the ability to perform spectacular combat maneuvers. You gain benefits when wearing light or no armor and not using a Shield.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.description: When you expend Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction, you can cause up to two allies you can see within 30 feet of you to move up to half their Speed.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage on a success. Moreover, when an ally within 5 feet of you makes a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that deals damage, you can take a Reaction to grant that ally the benefit of your Evasion.

entries.name: College of Glamour
entries.summary: Bards of this college have learned to weave fey magic into their performances.

rules.name: College of Glamour
rules.description: Bards of this college have learned to weave fey magic into their performances.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.description: You know the Command spell. For you, it counts as a Bard spell. Whenever you cast this spell, you can target two creatures instead of one.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and choose a number of willing creatures you can see within 60 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier. Each of them gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 2 times your Bard level and can move up to their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you take on an unearthly appearance for 1 minute. For the duration, as a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can cast Command without expending a spell slot, and a target you choose automatically fails its saving throw against the spell.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can assume a magically majestic presence for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. For the duration, whenever a creature hits you with an attack roll for the first time on a turn, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or the attack misses instead.

entries.name: College of Lore
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Lore collect knowledge from sources as diverse as scholarly tomes and peasant tales.

rules.name: College of Lore
rules.description: Bards of the College of Lore collect knowledge from sources as diverse as scholarly tomes and peasant tales.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in any three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: You learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll or an ability check, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, rolling that die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
features.description: You learn two spells of your choice from any spell list. The chosen spells must be of a level you can cast.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, roll the die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning the failure into a success.

entries.name: College of Valor
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Valor are daring skalds whose tales keep alive the memory of the great heroes of the past.

rules.name: College of Valor
rules.description: Bards of the College of Valor are daring skalds whose tales keep alive the memory of the great heroes of the past.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: When you grant Bardic Inspiration, the recipient can also add the die to a damage roll or to their AC against one attack.

features.name: Martial Training
features.description: You gain proficiency with Medium armor and Shields. In addition, when you attack with a Weapon as part of the Attack action, you can make one extra attack with a different Weapon as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with casting a spell that has a casting time of an action.

entries.name: Eldritch Knight
entries.summary: The archetypal Eldritch Knight combines the martial mastery common to all fighters with a careful study of magic.

rules.name: Eldritch Knight
rules.description: The archetypal Eldritch Knight combines the martial mastery common to all fighters with a careful study of magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You augment your martial prowess with the ability to cast spells. You learn cantrips and spells from the Wizard spell list.

features.name: War Bond
features.description: You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You can summon that weapon as a Bonus Action, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with casting one Wizard cantrip that has a casting time of an action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace two of your attacks with casting one Wizard spell that has a casting time of an action.

entries.name: Life Domain
entries.summary: The Life Domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy that sustains all life.

rules.name: Life Domain
rules.description: The Life Domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy that sustains all life.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend a use of Channel Divinity and present your Holy Symbol. You or a creature within 30 feet of you regains Hit Points equal to 5 times your Cleric level. This can't raise a creature's Hit Points above half its Hit Point maximum.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to a creature other than yourself, you also regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: When you roll dice to restore Hit Points with your spells, you can take the maximum result on each die instead of rolling.

entries.name: Light Domain
entries.summary: Gods of light promote the ideals of rebirth and renewal, truth, vigilance, and beauty.

rules.name: Light Domain
rules.description: Gods of light promote the ideals of rebirth and renewal, truth, vigilance, and beauty.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend a use of Channel Divinity and present your Holy Symbol. Any magical Darkness within 30 feet of you ends. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw, taking Radiant damage equal to 2d10 plus your Cleric level on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the roll. The attacker can't benefit from Advantage on the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.description: When you use Warding Flare, you can target any creature within 30 feet of you, not just yourself.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: As a Magic action, you activate an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute. It emanates from you in a 60-foot Emanation. Creatures of your choice in the Emanation have Disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals Fire or Radiant damage.

entries.name: Path of the Berserker
entries.summary: For some Barbarians, rage is a means to an end—that end being violence. The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood.

rules.name: Path of the Berserker
rules.description: For some Barbarians, rage is a means to an end—that end being violence. The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. The extra damage equals your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can strike terror into others with your menacing presence and bellowing fury. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier). On a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute.

entries.name: Path of the Wild Heart
entries.summary: Barbarians who follow this path draw their rage from the untamed wilds. These barbarians commune with animals and channel bestial spirits during their rages.

rules.name: Path of the Wild Heart
rules.description: Barbarians who follow this path draw their rage from the untamed wilds. These barbarians commune with animals and channel bestial spirits during their rages.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: You can cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals but only as Rituals.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.description: Your Rage taps into the primal power of animals. Whenever you activate your Rage, you can choose one of the following options: Bear, Eagle, or Wolf. The option you choose determines certain benefits while your Rage is active.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.description: You gain one of the following options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choice: Owl, Panther, or Salmon.

features.name: Nature's Speaker
features.description: You can cast Commune with Nature as a Ritual.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.description: Whenever you activate your Rage, you can choose two options from Rage of the Wilds rather than one.

entries.name: Path of the World Tree
entries.summary: Barbarians who follow this path connect themselves to the cosmic World Tree.

rules.name: Path of the World Tree
rules.description: Barbarians who follow this path connect themselves to the cosmic World Tree.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.description: Your Rage taps into the life force of the World Tree. When you activate your Rage, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: While your Rage is active, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.description: Tendrils of the World Tree extend from you. While your Rage is active, when you hit with a weapon attack, you can push the target up to 15 feet away from you.

features.name: Travel Along the Tree
features.description: When you activate your Rage, you can teleport yourself and up to six willing creatures you can see to a location you're familiar with on your current plane of existence.

entries.name: Path of the Zealot
entries.summary: Some deities inspire their followers to pitch themselves into a ferocious battle fury. These barbarians are zealots—warriors who channel their rage into powerful displays of divine power.

rules.name: Path of the Zealot
rules.description: Some deities inspire their followers to pitch themselves into a ferocious battle fury. These barbarians are zealots—warriors who channel their rage into powerful displays of divine power.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: You can channel divine power into your strikes. While your Rage is active, the first creature you hit on each of your turns with a weapon or Unarmed Strike takes extra damage equal to 1d6 plus half your Barbarian level. The extra damage is Necrotic or Radiant (your choice when you gain this feature).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: If any effect would raise you from the dead, you can choose to return with half your Hit Points or your full Hit Points. In addition, you don't need Material components for any spell that would return you to life.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: If you fail a saving throw while your Rage is active, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and you must use the new roll.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Rage Beyond Death
features.description: While your Rage is active, having 0 Hit Points doesn't knock you out. You still must make Death Saving Throws, and you suffer the normal effects of taking damage while at 0 Hit Points. However, if you would die due to failing Death Saving Throws, you don't die until your Rage ends.

entries.name: Trickery Domain
entries.summary: Gods of trickery are mischief-makers and instigators who stand as a constant challenge to the accepted order.

rules.name: Trickery Domain
rules.description: Gods of trickery are mischief-makers and instigators who stand as a constant challenge to the accepted order.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: As a Magic action, you give yourself or a willing creature you touch Advantage on Stealth checks. This blessing lasts until you finish a Long Rest or you use this feature again.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you expend a use of Channel Divinity and create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute or until you lose Concentration. The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.description: When you use Invoke Duplicity, you can teleport, swapping places with your illusion.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: You can create up to four illusory duplicates when you use Invoke Duplicity, and you can move any number of them each time you take a Bonus Action to move them.

entries.name: War Domain
entries.summary: War has many manifestations. Gods of war can inspire leaders, soldiers, and warriors.

rules.name: War Domain
rules.description: War has many manifestations. Gods of war can inspire leaders, soldiers, and warriors.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: When you or another creature within 30 feet of you misses with an attack roll, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity and grant a +10 bonus to the roll, potentially causing it to hit.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can make one attack with a weapon or Unarmed Strike. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
